subject: Shaping Medford Economic Development Plan
overview: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke and the Economic Development Transition Team presented the "Shaping Medford" report, a community-driven revitalization plan for the city's business districts. The presentation detailed upcoming infrastructure improvements, new master planning for Medford Square, and efforts to streamline processes for local businesses.

items.title: Introduction to Shaping Medford
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke introduced the Economic Development Transition Team and their comprehensive "Shaping Medford" report intended to guide future growth.

items.title: Economic Development Report Findings
items.summary: Co-Chair Richard Orlando presented findings from the report, which prioritized streetscape improvements, pedestrian safety, and mixed-use development across five city squares based on over 700 community inputs.

items.title: Medford Square Master Plan
items.summary: The Office of Community Development announced a $90,000 grant from the Metropolitan Area Planning Council to create a new Medford Square Master Plan, with a public forum scheduled for September 7.

items.title: Riverside Plaza and Facility Upgrades
items.summary: Officials updated the public on a $250,000 grant application for Riverside Plaza and the nearly completed $2.1 million in improvements to the Senior Center and Crystal Campbell Peace Garden.

items.title: Complete Streets Infrastructure Grants
items.summary: The city detailed $400,000 in funded safety projects under the Complete Streets initiative, including pedestrian enhancements at Brooks Elementary School and new bike lanes on Boston Avenue.

items.title: New Business Guide and Chamber Partnership
items.summary: The administration announced the upcoming release of a comprehensive guide to help entrepreneurs navigate city permits and discussed strengthened coordination with the Chamber of Commerce.

items.title: Upcoming Community Events
items.summary: The Mayor announced the official unveiling of the Crystal Campbell Peace Garden on September 25 and the return of Medford Day on October 23.
